title: ReadinessReport
description: Amends specs/053-e2e-scratch-provisioning/contracts/readiness-report.schema.json (FR-010/FR-011): elements[].ready (bool) is replaced by elements[].outcome (tri-state), and top-level ready (bool) is replaced by verdict (tri-state). Emitted on stdout by provision-e2e-target.sh (with or without --check-only) and rendered into the GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY of auto-update-spec-kit-scratch-preflight.yml. See ../data-model.md.

outcome.description: FR-001: the three outcomes a machine consumer must be able to tell apart without parsing remaining_action. not_checkable means the checking route's credential cannot answer this element at all (FR-002) -- never folded into missing.

remaining_action.description: Null iff outcome is 'ready'. Never null otherwise (FR-006). For outcome 'not_checkable', names the route that can check this element instead (FR-005).

verdict.description: FR-002/FR-003: all_clear iff every element is ready; not_clear if any element is missing (checked-and-missing outranks unverified, Edge Cases); unverified iff nothing is missing but at least one element is not_checkable. Never all_clear with a missing or not_checkable element present (FR-003). Maps 1:1 to provision-e2e-target.sh's exit status: 0 / 1 / 2 respectively (FR-004, SC-008; see ../contracts/cli.md).
